newsitem.title: USA: Star runs diary of woman in Morris affair.
newsitem.headline: Star runs diary of woman in Morris affair.

text.p: The prostitute who claimed a yearlong affair with presidential political adviser Dick Morris said Hillary Rodham Clinton ordered a controversial review of FBI files of Republicans, the supermarket tabloid Star reported on Friday.

Morris, who resigned last week after the Star reported he had an affair with the $200-an-hour call girl, called the first lady "the lightning rod for the marriage," who took the brunt of attacks aimed at her and President Bill Clinton, the tabloid said.

The prostitute, Sherry Rowlands, claimed in her diary that she asked Morris who ordered up the White House review of the highly sensitive FBI files of former Republican administration officials and aides, the Star said.
"He said, 'It was Hillary in 1993. She ordered them. She's a paranoid lady -- she did it,'" the diary said.

Reports this summer that the White House personnel security office had access to hundreds of the background files forced the resignation of Craig Livingstone, a former advance man for Clinton's 1992 campaign who headed the office.

Clinton and top aides have denied knowing anything about the FBI files. Livingstone said the review of some of the files to determine who should have White House security clearances happened because his office used an outdated list.
According to the Star, Morris also allegedly told the prostitute that Mrs. Clinton often bears the brunt of criticism directed at the couple.
"She stands tall in front of all adversaries and says, 'Come on, get me, put me in jail,'" Rowlands said.
The second instalment of the saga based on Rowlands' diary were released by the Star on Friday. It is scheduled to be on newsstands on Monday.
According to last week's Star story, Morris hired Rowlands weekly for almost a year in Washington and gave her information confidential to the White House inner circle.

Morris, 48, who is married to Connecticut attorney Eileen McGann, quit as one of the president's closest advisers last week when the story broke. Morris refused to comment on Rowlands' allegations, saying he was quitting so he did not become an issue in the campaign.
Another supermarket tabloid, the National Enquirer, said in its latest issue that Morris also has had a mistress in Austin, Texas, and fathered a daughter by her.

The child is now 6 years old, and the girlfriend is a 40-year-old part-time real estate broker, it said. The couple has been holding trysts in luxury hotels as Morris has worked for various politicians around the country, the Lantana, Florida-based tabloid said.
Clinton's campaign press secretary, Joe Lockhart, said he had "no comment" on both the Star or National Enquirer stories.
